issues.description: The main file reuses WORK names across baseline and AbelNoser passes. Preserve/interleave baseline FB12/LS12 and Trades/Holdings/Price for StockPerformance and FilerCost before the supported Table 10 repeat of the Thomson/CRSP preparation overwrites those WORK objects.
The supplied Table 10 branch consumes branch-specific AbelNoser activity and trade tables; a compatible source and the field/history contract have not yet been established.

SAS library roots, a writable COPYCAT staging/output location, export paths and date macros need coherent working-directory configuration; WRDS-specific defaults in comments are not evidence that a remote service is mandatory.
The baseline last-sell sort uses FILE although its generated dataset and surrounding sorts use FILER; verify and apply the minimal source-backed key correction before any future authorized run.

The inherited SAS batch startup failed while initializing TKELS; this does not establish a missing license or unavailable entitlement, and the frozen work item prohibits another SAS startup/retry. Usable SAS runtime and the required DBMS=STATA/DTA export capability therefore remain unverified.

FilerCost requests QRET from downloader_FBLS_ret, but StockPerformance creates that table with FB_RET and LS_RET. The intended sophistication score/field mapping is not stated; do not choose one return series or combine them without author specification.

The supplied Holdings producer does not create VALUE, while FilerCost selects HOLDINGS.VALUE when creating WORK.WEIGHTS. No later WEIGHTS consumer is visible in the supplied programs. Preserve this output stage and clarify the intended field or whether the unused stage is intentionally run; do not invent a value formula or silently drop it.

FilerCost uses BEG_YEAR and END_YEAR for its CRSP daily reads without defining them in that file. Configure them consistently with the supplied 2001–2017 source window while preserving the stated partial prior-quarter averages; do not infer a requirement for a complete 8- or 12-quarter history.

evidence.description: The datasheet identifies the three supplied SAS programs and their preparation/analysis-data tasks.
evidence.quote:
The SAS programs used to convert the raw data into the final datasets used in the analyses are
enclosed (CDYZ_Copycat_CopycattingActivity.sas, CDYZ_Copycat_StockPerformance.sas, and
CDYZ_Copycat_FilerCost.sas). The programs consist of the following key steps:

   -   Pre-processing of investment company holdings (13F) data

   -   Identifying copycatting activities

   -   Calculating returns for the portfolio analysis

   -   Merging with investment company level returns, investment company characteristics, and
       investee stock characteristics

evidence.description: The authors identify the prepared viewer-filer-quarter file as the full viewing sample and state that later regressions use Stata.
evidence.quote:
After we have prepared the final datasets, we use Stata to perform regression analyses. The full
sample of viewer-filer-quarter observations for viewing activities is provided in
“viewer_filer_qtr.sas7bdat.” The lists of viewing investment companies and disclosing companies
in the final dataset are provided in “List of Viewing Companies.xlsx” and “List of Disclosing
Companies.xlsx.” The list of hedge fund companies included in the proprietary cost analysis is
provided in “List of Hedge Fund Disclosing Companies.xlsx.”

evidence.quote:
proc sql; create table Weights
as select distinct a.mgrno, a.rdate, a.permno, a.value/b.Assets as weight
from Holdings as a, Assets as b
where a.mgrno=b.mgrno and a.rdate=b.rdate
order by mgrno, rdate; quit;

actions.description: Prepare a coherent native SAS staging root and execute the supplied branches in producer-consumer order, retaining baseline WORK outputs before the Table 10 pass overwrites the same names.
steps: Stage the exact packaged viewing and research-intensity inputs in the writable COPYCAT project library; keep shared CRSP and TFN sources read-only.

Run the baseline CopycattingActivity/Table 3 segment to create copy12, baseline WORK.FB12/LS12, Trades, Holdings, Price, and durable COPYCAT.COPYCAT_FB/LS. Run StockPerformance with those baseline WORK tables still present. Run FilerCost only after the A005 QRET-to-return-field contract is resolved and its other unresolved requirements are addressed.

Run the supplied FB/LS sophisticated and naive focal_group/save_as settings and high/low research-intensity settings before their final comparisons consume the group outputs. Repeat the Table 4 procedure with ROBOT in place of DOWNLOAD for Table 11 Panel B.

Before Table 10, execute the source-backed repeat of the Thomson/CRSP Part 1 preparation using 1 March 2002–31 December 2012 dates, then run the AbelNoser branch using its separate activity/transaction inputs; a macro change alone does not rebuild the Part 1 WORK tables. Do not pass its overwritten manager-key WORK.FB12/LS12 to baseline StockPerformance.
Set BEG_YEAR=2001 and END_YEAR=2017 in the FilerCost session configuration, matching the explicit source window while retaining the source's existing partial rolling means.
validation: Before a separately authorized execution, confirm the chosen root is writable, source-library datasets are visible, and every WORK/durable handoff retains the expected columns.

review_notes: All three supplied SAS programs, the complete datasheet/appendix, and all 17 frozen dependency IDs were reviewed. The frozen catalog and six bounded SAS metadata probes are cited in the assessment; the five successful probes read one row each and do not establish population or historical coverage. The TFN.S34 candidate probe timed out at 15 seconds and was not retried.

The packaged viewer_filer_qtr and research_intensity inputs are exact author-prepared routes with readable matching fields. Their bounded probes do not prove full coverage; no separate full sweep is required solely to recognize these routes. The XLSX files are company identifier lists, not full panels or consumed inputs. Historical EDGAR logs and WHOIS are not additional mandatory inputs for the supplied prepared viewer_filer_qtr consumer.

Baseline COPYCAT.COPYCAT_FB/LS are produced by CopycattingActivity and feed COPY12; baseline WORK.FB12/LS12 feed StockPerformance. StockPerformance creates downloader_FBLS_ret with FB_RET and LS_RET, while FilerCost requests QRET. Later AbelNoser code overwrites WORK.FB12/LS12 with manager-key schemas and produces distinct durable Table 10 outputs. The workflow trace preserves these separate handoffs.

Table 10 explicitly calls for repeating the earlier Thomson/CRSP Part 1 with the 2002–2012 dates. The documented repeat is a supported preparation recipe; changing macros alone is insufficient. StockPerformance also documents sophisticated/naive, high/low research-intensity, and Table 11B ROBOT runs.

Specific unresolved source contracts remain: FilerCost requests QRET although its supplied producer emits FB_RET/LS_RET, and FilerCost selects HOLDINGS.VALUE although the supplied Holdings producer creates SHARES_ADJ. No WEIGHTS consumer is visible. The FILE-to-FILER baseline sort correction, WRDS path setup, and BEG_YEAR/END_YEAR settings are source-backed preparation actions.

The SAS TKELS startup failure is inherited evidence; no retry, author-code execution, estimator execution, install, download, or source edit occurred. Stata regression drivers are described but unprovided and remain contextual. Commercial-source comments do not establish that the user's licensed/local access is unavailable.
